display_information.description: Talk to any specialist agent from Slack. /agent [agent-name] your message
display_information.long_description:
Respawn Signal Agent Studio brings your 12 specialist AI agents directly into Slack.

Use /agent to route any question to the right expert — backend, security, data engineering, LLM architecture, prompt engineering, and more. Agents can consult each other and post live updates in threads.

Available agents:
• agent-organizer — orchestrates multi-agent teams
• task-decomposition-expert — breaks down complex goals
• senior-backend — Node.js, Go, Python, APIs, databases
• frontend-developer — React, Vue, Angular, real-time UI
• data-engineer — pipelines, ETL/ELT, data infrastructure
• llm-architect — LLM systems, RAG, fine-tuning, inference
• prompt-engineer — prompt design, optimization, evaluation
• model-evaluator — model selection, benchmarking, cost
• security-engineer — security architecture, compliance
• error-detective — root cause analysis, error patterns
• search-specialist — web research, fact verification
• report-generator — research synthesis, structured reports
